cancelBooking.title: Cancel booking
cancelBooking.body: Are you sure you want to cancel this booking?

pauseWaitlist.title: Pause waitlist?
pauseWaitlist.body: While paused, members won’t be able to reserve a spot. When you reactivate it, the waitlist order will remain unchanged.

reactivateWaitlist.title: Reactivate waitlist?
reactivateWaitlist.body: Members already on the waitlist stay in the same order, and new added members will join at the bottom.

viewWaitlistMembers.title: Waitlist members
viewWaitlistMembers.subtitle: Members are still on the waitlist, but it is currently paused for this session.  You can reactivate it at any time and the existing order will be preserved.

isOptionBlocking.title: Save openings for waitlist members only
isOptionBlocking.description: A spot will be reserved for members on the waitlist until they book.

checkCredit.title: Require valid pass with sufficient credit
checkCredit.description: Members can only join waitlist if they have a pass compatible with this session and enough credits.

oneByOne.title: One-by-one
oneByOne.description: Members are ranked in order. The first person is notified automatically when a spot opens.

description.simple: When a spot opens, members receive {{autokick_delay}} reminders spaced {{dumb_delay_minutes}} minutes apart to book before their spot goes to the next person.
description.smart: When a spot opens, members receive {{autokick_delay}} reminders spaced at {{smart_delay_percentage}}% intervals of the remaining time before the session starts.

autoConsumePack.title: Auto-book from waitlist
autoConsumePack.description: Members are automatically enrolled when a spot opens and credits are deducted from their valid pass (up to {{last_delay_before_auto_consume}} minute before the session starts)
autoConsumePack.description_other: Members are automatically enrolled when a spot opens and credits are deducted from their valid pass (up to {{last_delay_before_auto_consume}} minutes before the session starts)

kickIfNoPack.title: Auto-remove without valid pass
kickIfNoPack.description: Members are removed from the waitlist if they no longer have a valid pass when their turn arrives.

firstComeFirstServed.title: First come, first served
firstComeFirstServed.description: All members that joined this waitlist will be informed simultaneously once a spot becomes available.

pausedWaitlistState.description: The waitlist is paused for this session
